Verify the new mailing address, legal residence, seasonal address if any, effective date, state tax implications to flag for the advisor, custodian forms required, and communication preferences. Record the update in the CRM and confirm completion to the client.

tickets.title: Coordinate education distribution request
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client requests a distribution for qualified education expenses. Confirm the account type, eligible student, payment destination, tax reporting considerations, and documentation needed before submitting instructions.

subTasks.title: Confirm distribution purpose and eligibility
subTasks.text: Verify the requested education expense category, student relationship, academic period, and whether the distribution should be paid to the client, beneficiary, or institution.

subTasks.title: Collect supporting documentation
subTasks.text: Request the invoice, tuition statement, room and board support if applicable, and any custodian-required distribution form. Confirm that documents are complete before processing.

subTasks.title: Review tax and planning considerations
subTasks.text: Check whether the distribution may affect education credits, scholarships, beneficiary changes, or prior-year reimbursements. Escalate any tax-sensitive questions to the advisor before submission.

subTasks.title: Submit and confirm distribution
subTasks.text: Prepare the custodian request, confirm delivery method, submit after approval, and save confirmation to the client record.
